from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import json
p=Path('analysis/probe-attempt-01.stdout.jsonl')
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in p.read_text().splitlines()]
for action in ('run','pass','fail','skip'):
 tests=Counter(r['Test'] for r in rows if r['Action']==action and 'Test' in r)
 roots={k:v for k,v in tests.items() if '/' not in k}
 print(action,sum(tests.values()),'distinct',len(tests),'roots',roots,'repetition counts',Counter(tests.values()))
print('package terminal',[(r['Action'],r.get('Package')) for r in rows if 'Test' not in r and r['Action'] in ('pass','fail','skip')])
print('stderr bytes',Path('analysis/probe-attempt-01.stderr.log').stat().st_size)
assert len([r for r in rows if r['Action']=='run' and r.get('Test','').startswith('TestIdentity')])>0
runs=Counter(r['Test'] for r in rows if r['Action']=='run' and 'Test' in r)
passes=Counter(r['Test'] for r in rows if r['Action']=='pass' and 'Test' in r)
assert runs==passes and set(runs.values())=={3} and any(r['Action']=='pass' and 'Test' not in r for r in rows)
